description: This file defines the InvalidURLException class within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, specifically for handling invalid URL errors for video platforms (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion). It provides static methods to generate exceptions with specific messages.

classes.name: InvalidURLException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, used for handling invalid URL errors related to the Buzz plugin.

methods.name: invalidYouTubeURLProvided
methods.description: Static method that returns an InvalidURLException with a message indicating an invalid YouTube URL.

methods.name: invalidVimeoURLProvided
methods.description: Static method that returns an InvalidURLException with a message indicating an invalid Vimeo URL.

methods.name: invalidDailymotionURLProvided
methods.description: Static method that returns an InvalidURLException with a message indicating an invalid Dailymotion URL.
